mobile.the_selected_branch_supplies_the_home_ba: The selected branch supplies the home base address and location. Without a branch, add the depot address below.
mobile.these_libraries_come_to_you_visit_times_: These libraries come to you. Visit times use each service’s local timezone.
mobile.mobile_library_route_map_stops_are_also_: Mobile library route map. Stops are also listed in the timetable.
mobile.paused_for_now_the_timetable_below_is_sh: Paused for now. The timetable below is shown as a record of the service.
mobile.service_planned_check_the_timetable_for_: Service planned. Check the timetable for the recorded start dates.
mobile.mobile_libraries_that_stop_near_you: Mobile libraries that stop near you
mobile.nearby_mobile_stops_are_temporarily_unav: Nearby mobile stops are temporarily unavailable.
mobile.your_location_stays_in_this_browser_dist: Your location stays in this browser. Distances are straight-line.
mobile.stops_do_not_have_map_pins_yet: Stops do not have map pins yet.
mobile.a_downloaded_calendar_is_a_snapshot_chec: A downloaded calendar is a snapshot. Check this page for changes before travelling.
mobile.suggest_a_correction_for_this_stop: Suggest a correction for this stop
mobile.no_stops_yet_choose_a_week_and_a_day_to_: No stops yet. Choose a week and a day to add the first one.
mobile.leave_blank_for_the_whole_year: Leave blank for the whole year.
mobile.select_a_day_to_edit_it: Select a day to edit it
mobile.include_stop_day_arrival_and_departure_h: Include Stop, Day, Arrival and Departure headings. Optional columns: Where, Weeks, Dates, Latitude and Longitude.
mobile.choose_a_stop_and_search_for_its_village: Choose a stop and search for its village or landmark. Check the result before placing its pin.
mobile.notices_publish_separately_from_the_time: Notices publish separately from the timetable and cancel visits while they apply.
mobile.no_notices_showing_the_timetable_runs_as: No notices showing. The timetable runs as published.
mobile.confirmation_lasts_12_hours_on_this_sign: Confirmation lasts 12 hours on this sign-in. After confirming, you can add a passkey to this account.
mobile.offline_2_check_ins_are_saved_on_this_ph: Offline. 2 check-ins are saved on this phone.
mobile.screen_locked_reopen_the_console_to_chec: Screen locked. Reopen the console to check in.
mobile.also_on_the_library_page_in_the_you_run_: Also on the library page, in the “You run this mobile library” card.
mobile.this_only_changes_the_preview_no_public_: This only changes the preview. No public update is sent.
mobile.interactive_preview_nothing_here_starts_: Interactive preview. Nothing here starts a live session or changes the public page.
mobile.what_the_public_sees_right_now: What the public sees right now
mobile.the_actual_public_page_trying_the_previe: The actual public page. Trying the preview doesn’t change this.
mobile.built_for_a_parked_vehicle_and_cold_hand: Built for a parked vehicle and cold hands: one primary button at a time, targets of 56 px or more, and the stop name in large type. Reopen the console to tap at each stop. Sharing position needs the page open with the screen on.
mobile.no_scheduled_service_today_the_console_c: No scheduled service today. The console can use a swapped day’s route.
mobile.ask_an_owner_to_let_you_go_live_they_cho: Ask an owner to let you go live. They choose who can, person by person.
mobile.the_console_link_has_been_emailed_to_you: The console link has been emailed to you.
mobile.the_link_could_not_be_emailed_open_it_wi: The link could not be emailed. Open it with the button or the QR code.
mobile.copying_is_blocked_here_use_the_qr_code_: Copying is blocked here. Use the QR code or email instead.
mobile.learn_more_going_live_from_your_phone: Learn more: Going live from your phone
mobile.scan_to_open_the_console_on_your_phone_s: Scan to open the console on your phone. Staff sign-in required.
mobile.add_the_console_to_your_phone_s_home_scr: Add the console to your phone’s home screen.
mobile.sign_in_once_inside_the_installed_app: Sign in once inside the installed app.
mobile.safari_share_add_to_home_screen: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
mobile.you_re_not_set_up_to_go_live: You’re not set up to go live
mobile.location_is_shared_only_between_stops_ro: Location is shared only between stops, rounded to about 250 m and a minute behind. Keep this screen on. Your browser will ask to use location after starting.
mobile.on_iphone_an_installed_app_has_its_own_s: On iPhone, an installed app has its own sign-in. Sign in once inside it.
mobile.sharing_stops_now_to_restart_today_you_l: Sharing stops now. To restart today you’ll confirm it’s you again.
mobile.not_running_breakdown_or_not_running_for: Not running: breakdown or not running for the rest of today
mobile.needed_each_day_before_you_share_live_up: Needed each day before you share live updates.
mobile.your_library_shares_stops_only_an_owner_: Your library shares stops only. An owner can allow approximate position in the Go live settings.
mobile.your_library_should_cover_live_tracking_: Your library should cover live tracking in its own staff data-protection checks.
mobile.no_live_sessions_yet_the_first_route_you: No live sessions yet. The first route you share appears here.
mobile.live_sessions_in_the_last_90_days: Live sessions in the last 90 days
mobile.the_settings_could_not_be_saved_check_yo: The settings could not be saved. Check your access and try again.
mobile.when_off_the_library_page_always_shows_t: When off, the library page always shows the timetable.
mobile.only_owners_can_change_live_sharing_sett: Only owners can change live sharing settings.
mobile.owners_choose_who_can_go_live_person_by_: Owners choose who can go live, person by person.
mobile.this_permission_could_not_be_changed: This permission could not be changed.
mobile.ask_an_owner_to_change_who_can_go_live: Ask an owner to change who can go live.
mobile.every_verified_staff_member_for_this_lib: Every verified staff member for this library can go live. Restrictions already set stay in force.
mobile.in_a_free_team_workspace_owners_choose_w: In a free team workspace, owners choose who can go live, person by person.
mobile.the_public_sees_which_stop_the_vehicle_i: The public sees which stop the vehicle is at, and “On the road” between stops.
mobile.shown_as_a_circle_about_250_m_wide_a_min: Shown as a circle about 250 m wide, a minute behind. Only when a crew member shares position.
mobile.staff_can_share_check_ins_from_the_vehic: Staff can share check-ins from the vehicle. Approximate position, when enabled, is shown only between stops, rounded to about 250 m and a minute behind. Positions are removed when the route ends.
mobile.i_confirm_the_service_allows_its_staff_t: I confirm the service allows its staff to share the vehicle’s position.
